_meta_itemized.notes: Roger Armstrong, County Council, 2020 POST-Election - and its two schedule pages are the SAME TWO SHEETS re-submitted verbatim from his Pre-Election filing 11859 (identical rows, identical struck specimens, identical boxed $421.61; only the scan skew and page framing differ). NO GRAIN AMBIGUITY, and this pair is useful evidence on the open question in the opposite direction from 24390 Wolbach: the cover of this Post-Election filing states 421.61 in the CURRENT REPORT column with last_report and cumulative_totals left blank, i.e. this filer treated the post-election report as the CUMULATIVE cycle statement and simply repeated it because nothing happened after the pre-election period. The ledger closes on the cover either way. CONSEQUENCE THE COORDINATOR SHOULD KNOW: 11859 and 12942 will each emit the same 2 contribution + 2 expenditure rows, so at the CANDIDATE-CYCLE grain Armstrong's $421.61 appears twice across the two filings. That is a true property of Summit's cumulative filing regime (each filing restates the cycle), not a duplicate-row defect - but any per-candidate rollup must de-duplicate across filings rather than sum them, which is exactly why cf_cycle is city-only. SOURCE PROPERTY: as on 11859, the template specimen rows are not merely left in place but explicitly STRUCK THROUGH by the filer. Privacy: both real contribution rows carry a street address; discarded at read time, only city/state ('Park City', 'UT') recorded. No in-kind schedule, no redactions.
